notes.title: Patch: Intro Cutscene Skip key, UI consistency!
notes.content:
[b]Note[/b]
- Skill Tree Currency Tooltip does still not work. Tested. Works perfectly in Editor in multiple ways. Just does not show in full demo build. We'll be trying new approaches each upcoming patch until it works.

[b]Patches[/b]
- You can now Skip the Intro cutscene with Jump Key
- NPCS now ACTUALLY have their interaction visual. More of an Unreal issue than anything we were doing wrong. Regardless they work now
- Ohelim Boss AI Improved
- Ohelim collision improved

notes.title: Bloodline(Skill-tree) & Feedback
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes #01 for Dynasthir Speedrunner Demo [/b]
- Bloodline (Skill Tree) Hovered, Activated and Unavailable Nodes updated to better reflect expectation
- Bloodline Essence Growth description renamed to reflect "HP" upgrade. HP also renamed to Life Essence in Stats
- Bloodline (Skill Tree) Tooltips for Upgrade Points should display, *this is untested*
- Hitting Cultist (Hooded guys) should be MUCH more consistent
- Player Weapons hitbox has increased slightly in size to match player expectations
- Graphical Settings added for Potato PCs, might break the visuals of the game, but they are there.
- Landscape should no longer pop out of Existence on the lowest Render Distance
